VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The requirements_trace (WIT) from the third-party reviewer directly verifies that structured audit logging (criterion C) is absent. The CI log (ATT) confirms tests pass but tests passing doesn't establish that all three features exist—it only proves the existing tests succeed. The self-report (SELF) is the weakest evidence and contradicts the independent review. Since criterion C is unmet, the work fails to satisfy ALL acceptance criteria.
